verdictRationale: The backend no longer invents currency, rate, fee, threshold or rule version and cannot create an accrual without an approved policy plus active tenant-matching attribution. Both legacy and V8 requests use one PostgreSQL transaction for payout row, commission links and payout.requested; advisory locking and tenant-scoped idempotency prove one effect under concurrency, rollback on failure and cold readback. Automatic payout is forced off and approval requires a different actor. The only remaining release blocker is the accountable Commercial + Finance + Legal decision.
openBlockers: Commercial + Finance + Legal must approve the base currency, versioned commission rule, eligibility and attribution window, payout fee/minimum, reversal/dispute treatment and tax responsibility.
The real-PostgreSQL proof used an explicitly synthetic APPROVED policy fixture for technical control only; it is not a production decision or authorization.
